name: Bitrise
description: Bitrise is a continuous integration and delivery platform for building, testing, and deploying mobile apps. Automate your development workflows and connect app builds and releases with other services.

events.d: Start a new build for a chosen app using branch, tag, workflow, commit, environments or secrets.
List builds of an app, filtered by branch, workflow, status or date.
Abort a running build; optionally provide a reason, mark it as successful, or skip notifications and git status report.
Retrieve build details and status by selecting an app and build slug.
Rerun a finished build with the same parameters and workflow.
Runs when a new build starts or finishes on a chosen app.
Retrieve artifacts (apps, logs, reports) from a selected app build, with optional limit and pagination.
Create a secret on an app or update its value if it already exists.

recipes.ae: List a record by Record ID
